schema_version: 1
contract: course_lifecycle_events
transport: NATS JetStream
producer: ms-go-course
subjects:
  course.created: {payload: [course_id, slug]}
  course.updated: {payload: [course_id, slug]}
  course.deleted: {payload: [course_id, slug]}
  task.created: {payload: [task_id, lesson_id]}
  task.updated: {payload: [task_id]}
  task.deleted: {payload: [task_id, lesson_id]}
delivery:
  - ordinary use cases publish after persistence succeeds
  - knowledge-import transactions defer publication until commit
  - a nil NATS connection makes publication a no-op
  - current use cases discard publisher errors, so events are best-effort rather than guaranteed
compatibility:
  - subject and payload changes require consumer inventory and rollout planning
  - do not claim transactional outbox or guaranteed delivery without implementing it
sources: [internal/domain/subjects.go, internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats/publisher.go, internal/usecase/course, internal/usecase/task]
